Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3772 (Metabotropic glutamate receptor 1). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3772, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
